title: AA Academy learning path
description: docs/learn/paths/<id>.yaml: an ordered list of modules for one role. Modules not written yet are listed under planned. Checked by tools/docs/check_learn.py (AA-1104).

audience.description: The role the path is for, named as a role (docs/STYLE.md).

required.description: false for an elective (for example the E11 to E14 deep dives).

planned.description: Module IDs of this path not written yet, in order; a prerequisite may name one.

final_quiz.description: true when the path ends with a mixed quiz drawn from every module (GUIDE-13 §4.3).
